title: god-cost.json
description: What each action in contracts.md §4.2 costs the god in favor, and optionally in materials. One record per action id, 0 through 16, with no gaps and no additions — the loader checks that separately, because a schema can require a shape but not a covering. Every magnitude is an untuned placeholder awaiting the balance harness (god-agency design.md).

materialCost.description: What the action costs in materials, per kind, fp. Optional: most actions name none, and an action naming a kind outside the seven fails the load here and again in load.ts, which names the action. Every value is a non-negative fp quantity of that stock. An empty object is refused by load.ts rather than by the schema: this interpreter enforces no minProperties, and a keyword added for one table would be a constraint nobody else could rely on.
